purpose: Acknowledge frozen S6-I1-I4 mathematical-contract gaps and authorize preparation only of a versioned mechanism-integrity amendment, deterministic fixtures and additive expected-red tests. This candidate preserves every frozen byte and does not authorize production repair, optimizer/evaluator execution or formal FFE.

decision_A_gap_acknowledgement.meaning: Treat the audit as a blocker for S6-E0 while preserving the existing freeze as historical evidence of its declared 46-test scope.

decision_J_stability.meaning: Compute stability over every upper-triangle pair of consecutive W matrices, including subthreshold positive weights, exactly as the frozen formula states.

decision_N_nmi_universe.meaning: Evaluate NMI over the prespecified truth-node universe; map every missing observed constraint to its own deterministic missing-node singleton so omission cannot receive credit.

decision_Q_relief_pool.meaning: After all target/p-best/distinctness exclusions, set relief-pool size to max(1, ceil(q times eligible_count)).

decision_U_unsuccessful_trials.meaning: Permit finite zero gain for rejected/equal trials; require strictly positive gain only for an accepted trial entering success-history memory.

decision_F_ffe_attempts.meaning: Increment an attempted-FFE ledger immediately before each oracle invocation, then record success, malformed output or exception separately; cache hits remain zero FFE.

decision_D_target_diagnostic.meaning: Keep global feasibility based on the complete violation vector and use NO_ACTIVE_TARGET_VIOLATION when an infeasible target has zero violation in all active graph communities.

decision_K_stable_id.meaning: Freeze one stable-ID schema and total ordering; recommended run-local non-negative integer evaluation IDs compared numerically, with mixed types rejected.

decision_W_rewire_control.meaning: Record requested/attempted/successful swaps and graph identity; if a non-identity degree-preserving rewire cannot be generated under the frozen policy, mark the control inapplicable/inconclusive rather than silently using the learned graph.

additional_mandatory_contracts: Validate finite objective and complete ordered residual length before a cache entry becomes usable.
Store immutable cache evidence and return a copy or read-only view so callers cannot mutate history.
Freeze a portable identifier grammar for matrix, algorithm, problem and attempt IDs.
Construct future filesystem paths from a digest and preserve display IDs only as metadata.
Preserve all existing frozen snapshots and add an explicit precedence layer rather than editing them.

decision_C_amendment_scope.meaning: Prepare an additive specification amendment containing the selected semantics. It remains proposed and ineffective until a separate hash-bound freeze authorization.

required_red_coverage: fixed truth-node NMI with missing observed constraints
mixed accepted and rejected trial generation with zero rejected gain
evaluator-attempt accounting on callback exception and malformed output using a forbidden-formal-FFE test double only
inactive-only target violation versus globally feasible target diagnostics
numeric stable IDs 2 versus 10 and mixed-type rejection
rewire achieved-swap telemetry and identity/inconclusive branch
portable resume identity and traversal rejection
decision_T_tdd_scope.phase_boundary: After exact author confirmation, only additive specifications, fixtures and expected-red/static tests may be prepared and run. Production implementation and any formal evaluator remain forbidden.

authorization_effect_if_confirmed: Record the selected mathematical and diagnostic semantics as author decisions.
Prepare a versioned additive mechanism-integrity amendment without freezing or activating it.

not_authorized_even_if_confirmed: Editing historical frozen source, tests, specifications, snapshots or acceptance records.
